items.title: 13.4 Gas ki average translational kinetic energy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.4, average translational kinetic energy of a gas (PDF 9-11).

blocks.text: Topic 13.3 mein humne kinetic theory se N molecules wali gas ka pressure nikala tha. Ab ise gas law PV = nRT ke saath milate hain:

Kitab yahan kehti hai ke M/m Avogadro's number hai (N_A = M m⁻¹); yeh tab sahi hai jab M ek mole ka mass (molar mass) ho aur m ek molecule ka mass. Gas constant R, Boltzmann constant aur Avogadro number ka relation (talluq): k_B = R/N_A.
Dono equations ko barabar rakhne se:
Yahan N/n = N_A ek mole mein molecules ki number (Avogadro number) hai. Is liye:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is line ke saath 'Boltzmann factor' likhti hai. Physics mein 'Boltzmann factor' aam taur par e^(−ΔE/k_BT) ko kehte hain (topic 13.5 dekhein). Yahan sirf yeh hai ke mv²ᵣₘₛ = 3RT/N_A = 3k_BT.
k_B = R/N_A istemal karte hue pressure wali equation yun likhte hain:
Is equation mein ½mv²ᵣₘₛ ek molecule ki average translational (seedhi line mein chalne wali) kinetic energy hai, jise <K.E.> likhte hain. Is liye pressure:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan P = ⅔<K.E._T> chhapti hai, jis mein N₀ (ek unit volume mein molecules ki number) reh gaya hai. Sahi P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T> hai, jaisa topic 13.3 mein derive hua.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Kinetic theory yeh samajhne mein madad deti hai ke pollutants (gandagi phailane wali cheezein) atmosphere (hawa ki tah) ke saath kaise interact karte hain (milte julte hain). Isi knowledge se hawa ki quality check karne wale systems banaye jate hain.
Eq. (13.17) mein v²ᵣₘₛ ki value rakhne se:

Yani gas molecules ki average translational kinetic energy sirf ek constant × temperature hai. Agar yeh model sahi hai to gas ka temperature us ke molecules ki average translational kinetic energy ka direct measure (seedha naap) hai: temperature (Kelvin mein) double to average K.E. bhi double.

Kamre ke temperature (300 K) par hawa ke molecule ke liye k_BT = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹ × 300 K = 4.14 × 10⁻²¹ J. Itni chhoti energy ke liye joule (J) ki jagah electron volt (eV) istemal karte hain. Electron volt woh kinetic energy hai jo electron ek volt ke voltage difference (farq) se accelerate ho kar (tez ho kar) hasil karta hai: 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J.
Boltzmann constant 8.62 × 10⁻⁵ eV K⁻¹ hai, is liye kamre ke temperature par k_BT = (8.62 × 10⁻⁵ eV K⁻¹)(300 K) = 0.026 eV.
Rozmarra zindagi mein kinetic theory of gases ki misalein

Popcorn aur gaari ke tyre ka pressure is ki misalein hain. Jab makai ka dana (popcorn kernel) garam hota hai to us ke andar band moisture (nami) steam (bhaap) ban jati hai. Daane ke andar pressure barhta hai, chhilka phat jata hai aur andar ka gelatinous (jelly jaisa) starch bahar aa jata hai, jo thanda ho kar sakht ho jata hai. (Kitab ki Fig 13.3 popcorn ki tasveer hai.)

Jab gaari ke tyre mein hawa bharte hain to andar hawa ke molecules ki number barhti hai aur pressure barhta hai. Volume limited (mehdood) hai, is liye zyada molecules tyre ki deewaron se zyada baar takrate hain. Yahi pressure tyre ko sakht rakhta hai aur pichke baghair gaari ka weight (wazan) uthata hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar gas ka absolute temperature double kar diya jaye to rms speed kitne guna hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: vᵣₘₛ = √(3k_BT/m), yani vᵣₘₛ ∝ √T. T double karne se vᵣₘₛ √2 ≈ 1.41 guna ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek hi kamre mein oxygen aur nitrogen ke molecules ki average kinetic energy barabar hai? Kya rms speed bhi barabar hai?
blocks.explanation: Average kinetic energy barabar hai, (3/2)k_BT, kyunke yeh sirf temperature par depend karti hai. rms speed barabar nahi: halke N₂ molecules tez chalte hain (25 °C par N₂ 515 m s⁻¹, O₂ taqreeban 481 m s⁻¹, Example 13.2).

rows: O₂ aur N₂ dono ki barabar: (3/2)k_BT
Sirf temperature par depend karti hai
Temperature aur molecule ke mass dono par depend karti hai
Halka N₂ tez (515 m s⁻¹), bhari O₂ dheema (481 m s⁻¹)

items: <K.E._T> = ½mv²ᵣₘₛ = (3/2)k_BT (13.18): temperature average K.E. ka measure (naap) hai.
Misalein: popcorn ka phatna, tyre mein hawa ka pressure.
